name: Pagan Kingdom
events: King Anawrahta seizes the throne of the Pagan Empire at Bagan in Burma (modern Myanmar).
King Anawrahta captures Thaton, the capital of the Thaton Kingdom, strengthening Theravada Buddhism in Burma.
King Kyansittha begins his reign as ruler of the Pagan Kingdom in Burma (modern Myanmar).
The administration of the Taungoo region (modern Myanmar) is first recorded.
City of Launggyet in Arakan (modern-day Burma) is founded according to some sources.
Thawun Gyi settles at Taungoo (modern-day Myanmar), and becomes the first ruler of the Toungoo dynasty…
